overall_notes: This is a survey paper reviewing existing research on Gricean maxims in NLP/NLG. It doesn't conduct new evaluations (automatic metrics, LLM-as-judge, or human evaluations) but rather synthesizes and categorizes existing work. The extraction incorrectly included evaluation methods from cited papers as if they were used in this paper.
